project_context.target_audience: Indian consumers buying premium cooking oils

typography.headings: Cormorant Garamond, serif (Weights: 400, 600, 700) - For brand authority and an organic artisan touch
typography.body: Outfit, sans-serif (Weights: 300, 400, 500) - Clean modern sans for highly legible mobile-first forms, OTP, and admin dash

layouts_and_grids.hero_section: Asymmetric layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12). Large typographic treatment spanning 7 cols, image overlapping spanning 5 cols.
layouts_and_grids.product_catalog: Cardless layout. Avoid standard white boxed shadow cards. Use flat colored backgrounds (#F3EFE6) for products with sharp CTAs.
layouts_and_grids.admin_dashboard: High density grid. Cardless tables for orders. 1px solid border (#E7E5DF). Dense spacing (gap-4).
layouts_and_grids.spacing_strategy: Generous. Use py-24 for marketing sections, gap-12 for bento grids. Use p-8 for inner containers.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for marketing primary CTAs. Sharp (rounded-md) for admin dashboard.
components.navigation_header: Sticky glassmorphism header. DO NOT make it fully transparent. Must be readable over scroll.
components.cart: Use Shadcn Sheet component for side-drawer cart experience.
components.otp_login: Centered clean dialog or dedicated page with large spaced inputs for the OTP. Focus states must have high contrast ring (#1B4332).
components.product_variants: Radio group blocks with clear size (500ml, 1L, 5L) and price breakdown.

motion.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion.interactions: Hover states on products: -translate-y-2 and shadow-lg. Framer motion staggered entry for product lists.

hero_oil_pour.description: Use for parallax hero background or visual storytelling of pure oil.

groundnut_ingredient.description: Visual element for Groundnut Oil section.

coconut_ingredient.description: Visual element for Coconut Oil section.

natural_ingredients.description: Visual element for natural/almond ingredients representation.

oil_bottle_placeholder.description: Use as standard product imagery in store catalog.

indian_kitchen_lifestyle.description: Trust building imagery for Indian audience.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install specific fonts: Cormorant Garamond and Outfit via Google Fonts.
Install and use @phosphor-icons/react for duotone elegant icons in marketing pages, lucide-react for the dashboard.
Ensure the application routes cover: Home, Shop, Product Detail, Cart Drawer, Checkout, OTP Login, User Orders, Admin Dashboard.
Follow 'Bento Grid Protocol' for feature showcasing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this by making creative, distinctive frontend layouts.
No generic centered layouts; use grids, optical alignment, and asymmetry.
Do not center-align the app container via .App { text-align: center; }.
Never use dark colors as gradients.
Do not use completely transparent backgrounds for headers/dropdowns. Use glassmorphism.
Apply 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (forms, buttons, inputs, cart interactions).
Use 2-3x more spacing (Tailwind p-8 to p-16) to create breathing room.
